flaps._comment: C-17 manual documents fixed-vane double-slotted flaps and the configuration display; exact MSFS handle detent percentages still need in-sim verification, so labels are intentionally broad.

grades._comment: Heavy tactical transport bands; partial until C-17-specific landing criteria are verified.

lvars._comment: This profile uses documented standard SimVars only; no Miltech-specific telemetry routes are enabled.

spoilers._comment: The C-17 uses spoiler/speedbrake behavior, but the cited sources do not define an external armed/readback variable. Use standard percent handling only.

controls._comment: Only standard gear/flaps surface fallback is allowed. Thrust-rating, engine shutoff, tactical reverse, flight-control, cargo/ramp, and AFCS writes remain unavailable until exact variables/events are verified.

meta.notes: Source-backed profile for the Premium Deluxe/Aviator Boeing C-17 Globemaster III. The official manual provides strong product, engine, and systems context, but no external variable/control map, so custom telemetry and cockpit writes stay inactive.

sources.notes: Documents the C-17 as a 4-engine heavy-lift military transport, engine count/type, F117-PW-100 thrust, flap type, engine throttle axis guidance, thrust rating modes, and systems context. No external LVAR/B-var/control variable list is provided.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 Avionics Framework - SimVars
sources.notes: Documents standard MSFS SimVars/A-vars as queryable simulator state. This profile intentionally activates no aircraft-specific L: or B: variables.

Flap labels are intentionally broad because runtime handle detents and percentages need in-sim verification.
The cited sources do not define a C-17 LVAR, B-var, or input-event integration map.
